name: QD Laser, Inc.
summary: QD Laser, Inc. offers semiconductor laser-based solutions in Japan, the United States, Europe, China, other parts of Asia, North America, and the Middle East. It operates through two segments: Laser Device Business and Laser Eyewear Business. The company's products include semiconductor lasers/epitaxial wafers; and RETISSA display II, RD2CAM, RETISSA medical, and medical device products. Its products are used in silicon photonics, VISIRIUM technology, sensing, and precision machine equipment applications.
